definition: A strategy is graded only after at least the minimum number of graded selections in its division.
threshold: PROPOSED: ≥100 graded selections per strategy (owner decision required)
verification: NOT RUN — no graded selections exist

definition: All reported metrics must come from walk-forward, out-of-sample periods. In-sample performance is never displayed or scored. Train/test splits are fixed before grading.

Median CLV of graded selections must be positive vs the closing line of an owner-approved licensed odds source. This is the primary luck-removal control: a strategy that consistently beats the close is skill-consistent even when short-run results vary.
threshold: PROPOSED: median CLV > 0 over the graded sample (owner decision required)

definition: Maximum observed bankroll drawdown during the graded period must stay within the cap.
For probability-style strategies, Brier score must beat the baseline (e.g., all-TBD naive model) on the same out-of-sample window.
threshold: PROPOSED: Brier < naive baseline (owner decision required)

definition: Combined correlation exposure of any multi-leg ticket must stay below the cap once pair correlations are measured. Until measured (IR-025), multi-leg tickets are NOT publishable by this system.
threshold: PROPOSED: cap value set after first correlation study (owner decision required)

definition: Strategy results must beat a shuffled-selection baseline (same bet count and sizing, random selection among the same opportunity set) across bootstrap resamples, proving the edge is selective skill, not sequence luck.
threshold: PROPOSED: beat 95% of shuffled baselines (owner decision required)

definition: Every graded selection must be settled from an official result source (NFL.com game pages / official stats), and every strategy submission must be a deterministic documented rule that another session can reproduce without manual judgment.
verification: ENFORCED BY DESIGN — matches the repo's verification rules
